Theo Parnell

A former member of Aaron Keener's team who is named as the first target in Year 6 Season 2 and appears in the Warlords of New York Tombs mission capture.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision game universe Canon scopegame canon Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Recorded Warlords encounter

The Tombs is the recorded Warlords of New York mission context for Parnell in the archive capture. A later official season places him among Keener's former team members and makes him its first named target. [1][2]
